name: Ecosprin 75 Tablet

medicine_desc: Emeset 8 Tablet is an antiemetic medicine commonly used to control nausea and vomiting due to certain medical conditions like stomach upset. name: Euthyrox 100 Tablet

name: Eglucent Rapid 100IU/ml Solution for Injection
